context: A married couple plans a summer family weekend
purpose: Teach: フライト/プロモーション/アナウンス/まつり/街道/庭園/ポーズ/ディレクター

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度の週末、街道沿いの庭園で夏まつりやるよ。
lines.en: There's a summer festival this weekend at the garden along the highway.
lines.style: Warm, informative tone. Opened with gentle enthusiasm as she shares news. Conversational pace, settling comfortably — she knows he'll like this.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お、いいね。プロモーション動画もネットに上がってたよ。
lines.en: Oh, nice. I even saw the promo video online.
lines.style: Genuine interest with a light, easy tone. Quick pickup on her news. A small pleased note on the acknowledgment — the kind of warm agreement that says 'I'm already thinking about it too.'

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 子供たち、ステージのアナウンスを楽しみにしてる。
lines.en: The kids are already excited about the stage announcements.
lines.style: Tender observation, almost to herself. A note of affection softening the words — she's picturing them. Pace unhurried, as if she's enjoying the thought before sharing it.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ディレクターさん知り合いだから、ちょっと顔出すか。
lines.en: I know the director, so we can definitely make an appearance.
lines.style: Casual confidence, slightly self-aware humor. Light touch of familiarity in the delivery — no big deal, just a connection he's letting her know about. Relaxed shoulders in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家族みんなで記念ポーズ撮ろう。
lines.en: Let's all get a family photo together while we're there.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion with quiet intention behind it. A slight warmth on 'all' — she wants this moment held. Not pushing, just guiding. Soft, decisive.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 帰りに、空港でフライトの写真でも撮って帰るか。
lines.en: And on the way home, maybe we'll grab a shot of the sky from the airport.
lines.style: Playful extension of the idea — she's already imagining the whole day unfolding. Light, unhurried pace. A small smile in the trailing thought, like she's painting a picture he'll enjoy too.
